The '''PT-97 Pubtrans Flitter''' was a model of [[Airspeeder/Legends|flitter]] designed by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] and used by public transportation systems. It measured 7.5 meters in length, and had a flight ceiling of up to a kilometer. The PT-97 could transport up to two passengers, and required a pilot to operate.
